Preveri končna polja po 20 undo/redo, ne vsakega vmesnega stanja; vzorec ne razloči napačnega zavrženja najnovejših od pravilnega zavrženja najstarejših pri ponavljajočem se redu. T04 preveri onemogočen robni gumb, dejanja ne sproži. Manjkajo tudi reset pri polnem skladu, dejanski no-op reset z nepraznim redo ter zahtevni ID-ji. To so konkretne vrzeli dokazov, ne potrjena napaka končne funkcionalnosti.

evenLengthComparison.note: Historical Luna A uses 22 alternating moves, so its boundary oracle does not distinguish these windows. The corrected new cases use 21 moves, whose boundary oracle does. Parity and actual assertions matter; two-state alternation alone is not a sufficient critique.

calibration.note: A score of 2 does not require 600 actions or the same test count as Astra. The new score-1 reviews identify concrete remaining core edges (invalid action/reset with redo, capacity/reset interaction, lifecycle or mobile board) in addition to limits of history oracles. Historical archives and scores are unchanged.
